notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout, no block. robots.txt has only a generic '*' group (no ClaudeBot-specific disallow); its Disallow list uses a stale locale URL pattern (e.g. '*/gb/en/') that does not match the site's actual current locale paths (e.g. '/en-gb/'), so category browsing is unaffected. Locale choice: the site geo-gates by country via a selector modal on the bare domain; robots.txt lists per-locale sitemaps (fi-fi, sv-se, de-de, nl-nl, nl-be, en-gb, en-ie). The Finland-market locale (fi-fi, 1900 sitemap URLs, 1605 product URLs) sells THREE ADDITIONAL Fiskars-Group sister brands mixed into its general nav (Arabia, Rorstrand, Hackman - own top-level sections plus items folded into the general tableware/home-decor listings), which would contaminate an 'Iittala' company count with non-Iittala products. The en-gb locale (936 product URLs) sitemap contains ZERO Arabia/Rorstrand/Hackman product paths (verified) - it is a clean single-brand Iittala catalogue - so en-gb was used as the extraction base to keep scope strictly to the assigned company 'Iittala', despite country=Finland; this is analogous to the HAY US case (c28.json) where the architecturally 'global' domain is used as the operative catalogue. Count method: category listing pages are Coveo-JS-rendered (data-categories/Coveo search widget, no SSR product tiles, no visible result-count text in raw HTML; CoveoSearchToken endpoint returned empty body so the Coveo API could not be queried directly) - so qty was derived via Rule 1's sanctioned 'enumerate to exhaustion counting unique product IDs' method against the en-gb sitemap.xml (https://www.iittala.com/en-gb/sitemap.xml, 1170 URLs, 936 product URLs, product paths end in a 6-8 digit or k-prefixed SKU id and sit directly under their category folder). Verification: every leaf-category product-ID count was summed per branch and reconciled EXACTLY against that branch's raw total product-URL count with zero unaccounted leftovers - home-decor branch: 377 total product URLs = 350 in-scope (candles-and-candle-holders 68 incl. the scented split below + decorative-objects 160 + lamps 21 + vases-plant-pots 107) + 21 excluded interior-textiles + 0 easter-decorations (empty) + 0 all-home-decor-items (pure roll-up, no own products); tableware branch: 559 total product URLs = 474 in-scope (drinkware 233 + plates-and-bowls 197 + serveware 44) + 85 excluded (cookware 16 + cutlery 69) + 0 on every 'all-X'/'kaikki' shop-all node (confirmed empty, pure aggregators). This exact reconciliation is strong evidence the sitemap is a complete, non-lossy product index for this site. Rule 0.6: site has both a room/lifestyle-flavoured nav (Home Decor, Kitchen & Dining/Tableware) and a designer/collection nav (/en-gb/collections/all-collections/<series>, e.g. Teema, Kastehelmi, Ultima Thule) - the collections tree is a pure cross-cut of the SAME products by design-series (facet re-cut), so per rule it is dropped, not double-counted; likewise /en-gb/home-decor/vases-plant-pots/vases/ceramic-vases and .../glass-vases carry zero distinct product URLs of their own (all 79 vase products sit directly at the parent 'vases' path) confirming they are material-facet re-cuts of the same 'Vases' listing, not separate branches - only the parent 'Vases' leaf is emitted. Mixed roll-up handled per rule ('drop, don't pad'): the 'Candles' node (12 SKUs) mixes 6 unscented candles (iittala-taper-candle x3, taika-candle x3) with 6 explicitly 'scented-candle' titled Alvar Aalto SKUs; only the 6 unscented SKUs are counted, the 6 scented ones dropped (Home Fragrance exclusion). The dedicated 'Scented Candles' node and 'Easter Decorations' node were both empty (0 product URLs) at time of extraction, so no rows are emitted for either regardless. Excluded per brief: all-tableware/all-cookware/all-cutlery/all-drinkware/all-plates-and-bowls/all-serveware/all-home-decor-items ('Shop All' roll-ups), Collections/all designer-series pages, Sale, Outlet ('Finds'), New Arrivals, Black Week, Gifts (by occasion/price/recipient - Gift Guide), Christmas (Holiday), Universe (Inspiration/Buying Guides/Community/Destinations/Manifesto - blog/content), interior-textiles (bathroom/home/kitchen textiles), cookware, cutlery. Duplicate-company check: not flagged in this window's duplicate list; S.N. 149/150 (Nordic Nest, RoyalDesign) are Nordic marketplaces that carry Iittala as one of many brands - a fundamentally different question (marketplace listing vs this brand's own DTC storefront), not a duplicate per the brief's own framing, so no exclusion/cross-reference was applied.
